program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((rects (for*/list ((r1 (range 0 h)) (c1 (range 0 w))
                             (r2 (range r1 h))
                             (c2 (range c1 w))
                             #:when
                             (let ((clr (at g r1 c1)))
                               (and
                                 (!= clr 0)
                                 (for*/and ((rr (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (cc (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
                                           (= (at g rr cc) clr)))))
                           (list (* (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))
                                 (at g r1 c1)
                                 r1
                                 c1
                                 r2
                                 c2)))
                  (sorted (sort rects (lambda (a b) (> (first a) (first b)))))
                  (best (first sorted))
                  (clr (second best))
                  (br1 (third best))
                  (bc1 (fourth best))
                  (br2 (list-ref best 4))
                  (bc2 (list-ref best 5)))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (cond
                        ((and (>= r br1) (<= r br2) (>= c bc1) (<= c bc2)) clr)
                        (else 0)))))))
